description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. We are a remote-first company with a global team and a culture driven by integrity, accountability, and progress.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is committed to helping end users who need assistance.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks.
  • Support end users via channels such as Slack and Jira; own the first line of support.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; manage onboarding and offboarding of employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, tools and policies; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on identity providers and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects with agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows in Okta; strong API integration skills.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; capable of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across media; clear, concise, and culturally sensitive communication.
  • Proficiency in documentation, tickets, emails, and Slack communications.
  • Strong problem-solving ability with knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Fit

We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values: act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. A builder’s mindset, adaptability, resilience, and the ability to operate in ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment are highly valued. We value collaboration, empathy, and impact across functions and cultures.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one; competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote work opportunity worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven role with opportunities for growth in a global digital asset company.

About Our Environment & Application Process

Ledn is globally distributed with a remote-first culture. Due to high volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

EEO & Contact

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity and diversity. You may reach out for accommodation requests during all stages of the recruitment process at the designated email. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.

Responsibilities

  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel-specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.
  • Monitor real-time campaign performance and proactively adjust bids, budgets, and targeting to improve efficiency and results.
  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

title: Digital Media Planner/Buyer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.

Media Planning & Strategy

  • Develop comprehensive media plans aligned with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct in-depth research and analysis to identify optimal media channels and strategies.
  • Determine budget allocation across channels based on performance and objectives.
  • Stay abreast of emerging digital media trends, technologies, and AI integrations.
  • Advise the New Business teams and Account teams on recommended budgets and media strategies during the pitch process.

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Oversee the execution of paid media campaigns across various platforms (e.g., Google Ads, social media platforms, programmatic display).
  • Manage relationships with external vendors responsible for day-to-day campaign management.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.
  • Analyze campaign performance data to identify areas for optimization and improvement. Generate regular reports on campaign performance and insights.

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.).
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

Responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing logistics activities related to international trade operations (imports and exports), third-party logistics (3PL) warehouse management, and national deliveries. International Trade Coordination

  • Coordinate with carriers and logistics partners to ensure on-time and complete deliveries (OTD)
  • Manage transportation documentation and follow up on deliveries through to customer confirmation

Cost and Process Optimization

  • Analyze and optimize logistics costs related to storage, transportation, and customs
  • Propose and implement continuous improvements in distribution, warehousing, and trade operations
  • Negotiate rates and service terms with logistics and freight providers

Operational Monitoring and Control

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs): delivery times, route compliance, service levels, inventory turnover, etc.
  • Prepare logistics performance reports and present findings to senior management
  • Manage and resolve logistics incidents, including delays, product damage, returns, and losses

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate closely with purchasing, sales, customer service, and finance departments to align logistics operations with business goals
  • Communicate delivery timelines, operational constraints, and critical updates to internal teams and customers

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, International Trade, or related fields
  • 3–5 years of experience in logistics coordination roles, including international trade, 3PL operations, and national distribution
  • Knowledge of import/export processes and customs regulations
  • Proficiency in Incoterms, tariff classification, and trade agreements
  • Advanced English (written and spoken)
  • Experience with TMS and ERP systems – SAP / TOTVS Datasul

Preferred Requirements

  • Certification or diploma in logistics, supply chain management, or international trade
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with logistics cost analysis and KPI management
  • Operational leadership and strategic planning abilities
  • Problem-solving in logistics and supply chain environments
  • Effective communication and negotiation skills
  • Adaptability and stress management in dynamic contexts

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!

  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Security Engineers, Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Ledn offers a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is a diverse group united by the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy, and Ledn’s products & services can play a critical role in doing so. Our core values are integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services and invite you to join us.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. You will also design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

What You Will Do

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams; define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services; automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD; conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features; partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications; enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens); collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows; define secure session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads; integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments; ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services with least-privilege IAM and secure key management; improve Kubernetes security posture; deploy and operate a SIEM framework with detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks; support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • Minimum 10 years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals; ability to remediate vulnerabilities identified in penetration test reports.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Have

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Experience on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role:

We’re partnering with an innovative early-stage company revolutionizing pet health through smart, connected technology. Their product is a next-generation collar-mounted device that leverages IoT and AI to monitor pet activity, wellness, and location in real-time — helping both pet parents and veterinarians take proactive care decisions.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our Firmware team. If you’re passionate about low-level development and excited to shape the future of pet tech, this role is for you.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with LTE and GNSS technologies.
  • Familiarity with MEMS sensors .
  • Working knowledge of Python for scripting or automation.

title: SDR Pleno
description:
Overview

SOBRE A BUZZCREATORS
A Buzzcreators é uma plataforma brasileira especializada em conectar marcas com influenciadores, especialmente micro e nano influenciadores, para a criação e gestão de campanhas de marketing de influência. Ela oferece uma solução automatizada e baseada em dados para facilitar todo o processo, desde o planejamento até a execução e pagamento das campanhas.

Vaga - 100% HOME OFFICE

O que buscamos

O SDR em vendas (Sales Development Representative, ou Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas) terá a responsabilidade de identificar e qualificar leads, estabelecer contatos, criar oportunidades de negócio e auxiliar os times comerciais. Além disso, atuará na etapa pré-vendas, com habilidades específicas, antes de as vendas começarem.

Atividades

  • Prospecção ativa 100% focada em Outbound de empresas e agências interessadas e com potencial para se tornarem clientes Buzzmonitor;
  • Compreensão das necessidades/dores de negócio do cliente;
  • Apresentação de plataforma para solucionar essas necessidades;
  • Mapeamento de necessidades e potenciais projetos.

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino superior em andamento ou completo;
  • Experiência na posição de SDR/Inside Sales;
  • Experiência com metodologia de venda BANT;
  • Experiência com Google Docs ou Microsoft Office;
  • Experiência com processo outbound;
  • Experiência com criação de listas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Técnica de vendas: Spin Selling;
  • Prospecção ABM;
  • Experiência no setor de Marketing Digital;
  • Experiência com Atendimento (SAC 4.0);
  • Experiência com tecnologia ou software SaaS;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de captação de cliente e validação de email (Sales Engagement).

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety

Remote - must be based in Brazil

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead our Video Safety engineering team. This critical role involves overseeing the development and enhancement of our innovative video safety software product, designed to improve the safety of commercial truck drivers on the road. Our system utilizes in-cab dashcams to detect and report safety-critical events such as driver fatigue, close following, and lane departure warnings. These events are then reviewed by back-office administrators via a dedicated portal.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing regular feedback and supporting their professional growth and career development.
  • Implement and maintain high engineering standards, best practices, and processes across the team to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and reliable software.
  • Coordinate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and other engineering teams, to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions, working with a global team spanning North America, Europe, and Latin America (Brazil).
  • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Drive technical excellence and innovation, ensuring the team leverages appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure the team's adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
  • Act as a technical leader, providing guidance and expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS), backend development (Kotlin), and front-end technologies (React).
  • Champion a safety-first mindset within the engineering team, ensuring the product's features and performance directly contribute to safer driving practices.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin and Java

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience in software development in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience managing and leading high-performing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical proficiency in cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others relevant to scalable applications.
  • Experience with front-end technologies, particularly React.
  • Demonstrated experience with scaled, high-availability systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum) and best practices.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of leading with empathy, fostering a positive team environment, and effectively managing individual and team performance.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with video processing, computer vision, or IoT applications is a plus.
  • Advanced/Fluent english is mandatory - written and speaking

Desired Attributes

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to understand the broader business context and translate it into technical strategies and team goals.
  • Result-Oriented: Drives for measurable results and holds the team accountable for commitments.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Collaborative: A natural team player who builds strong relationships and fosters a cooperative work environment.
  • Passionate about Safety: Genuinely cares about the impact of our product on commercial truck driver safety.

Overview

Auxiliar Governança - Gestão Governança (Hotelaria) - Hospital Aeroporto

Descrição :

Requisitos:

  • Formação; Mínimo Ensino Médio Completo
  • Desejável Experiência com atendimento ao público

Atividades:

  • Liberar os leitos após Desinfecção Terminal, com aplicação do checklist, identificar não conformidades a serem corrigidas
  • Verificar as condições de limpeza de todo ambiente e quando necessário acionar a supervisora de higienização/encarregada
  • Realizar a abertura do chamado para o setor de Manutenção quando necessidade de conserto/reparos de móveis e equipamentos dos leitos e das áreas comuns
  • Realizar entrega de controles de TVs e ar condicionado
  • Iniciar e finalizar altas no sistema Tasy, e informar a gestão de leitos, leitos bloqueados
  • Realizar visitas diárias nas unidades de internamento, preencher o formulário de visitas
  • Realizar o teste de Limpeza após desinfecção terminal, com luminol ou ATP, e informar resultado por e-mail
  • Apoiar a supervisora de governança na medição do SLA do Serviço de Higiene e Resíduos
  • Sempre que necessário realizar levantamentos dos itens com danos ou com necessidade de reposição da UNI
  • Apoiar quando necessário nas entregas de enxovais da Rouparia
  • Apoiar nos eventos de hotelaria, organização do espaço, entregar brindes aos clientes
  • Contribuir com supervisora de governança no processo de formação de novos colaboradores, através do treinamento prático e o acompanhamento

title: Manipulador de Saneantes
description:
Job description


A OSID – Obras Sociais Irmã Dulce é uma das maiores instituições filantrópicas do país, com cerca de 5,6 milhões de procedimentos ambulatoriais por ano, na Bahia, a usuários do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), idosos, pessoas com deficiência e com deformidades craniofaciais, pessoas em situação de rua, usuários de substâncias psicoativas e crianças e adolescentes em situação de risco social.


A entidade conta com um perfil de serviços único no Brasil, distribuídos em 21 núcleos que prestam assistência à população de baixa renda nas áreas de Saúde, Assistência Social, Pesquisa Científica, Ensino em Saúde, Educação e na preservação e difusão da história de sua fundadora, Santa Dulce dos Pobres.



Main responsibilities



  • Dispensar saneantes via comunicado interno e/ou solicitação via MV;

  • Controlar temperatura do ambiente;

  • Auxiliar na realização de inventários periódicos dos produtos estocados;

  • Controlar saneantes segregando do estoque produtos vencidos e informando ao coordenador de setor produtos com vencimento próximo;

  • Realizar acuracidade diária dos produtos do estoque;

  • Conferir e controlar a entrada e saída de produtos do estoque;

  • Manter a ordem e limpeza das prateleiras, caixas plásticas, pallets, carrinhos, armários e estações de trabalho;

  • Coletar e separar diariamente as bombonas vazias de saneantes nos setores destino;

  • Realizar a limpeza de bombonas e almotolias;

  • Preenchimento diário de protocolos e ficha técnica de manipulação dos saneantes diluídos;

  • Preparar a etiqueta de cada produto diluído na central de diluição e rotular toda a produção;

  • Diluir e envasar os saneantes em almotolias e bombonas e entregar nos setores destino.



Requirements and skills



  • Ensino médio completo;

  • 06 meses de experiência em cargos similares.



Additional information



  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;

  • Vale transporte;

  • Alimentação no refeitório da empresa.

Job description

Somos a 1° startup do Brasil a ter operações de Contact Center 100% no modelo home office.

Você é apaixonado por alcançar metas, está motivado a superar desafios e se colocar no lugar do outro enquanto faz parte de uma equipe dinâmica? Aqui é o seu lugar!!

Estamos à procura de profissionais dedicados, ambiciosos, apaixonados por alcançar metas e motivados a superar desafios para integrarem nossa equipe como Agentes de Atendimento, focados no SAC Multiskill para o e-commerce de uma marca de roupas e calçados.

Buscamos nos conectar com pessoas e aqui a gente preza pela igualdade de oportunidades e a inclusão da diversidade para todos os públicos. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades

  • Agente de solução em atendimento Multiskill via voz, ticket, e-mail e chat do e-commerce de uma rede de marcas de roupa de grife e calçados;
  • Você irá atender trocas e devoluções, estorno e reembolso;
  • Direcionar as reclamações e elogios recebidos aos setores/departamentos responsáveis;
  • Em todos os canais de comunicação é necessário ouvir atentamente o cliente buscando sempre o envolver, conduzir de forma prática o contato, possuir empatia, compreendendo a necessidade do cliente;
  • Nas mídias sociais será responsável por responder as reclamações e elogios dos clientes dos nossos anúncios.

Requisitos e habilidades

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência com atendimento em SAC de vestuário/e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento básico no ramo da moda;
  • Possuir agilidade, escrita e dicção boa;
  • Experiência com atendimento em multicanais – voz, chat e e-mail;
  • Possuir habilidades em atuar no modelo home office;
  • Ter um espaço adequado para atuar home office (Mesa, cadeira e ambiente sem ruído);
  • Residir em São Paulo/ Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencial em escritório no bairro Vila Olímpia sempre que requerido pela empresa/liderança;
  • Possuir internet cabeada com mais de 10 MB (Sem utilizar o Wifi);
  • Habilidade em manusear diversos plataformas de trabalho (Zendesk, WhatsApp, Telefone, chat e Pacote Office).

Escala de Trabalho: 6x1 – Horário a combinar de acordo com operação

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Auxilio Creche (Crianças de até 24 meses);
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TotalPass;
  • Descontos em cursos, faculdade e parques de diversão.

Fornecemos Notebook, Mouse e Headset.

title: Principal Architect São Paulo, Brazil, Remote
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A \"Whatever it takes\" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

description:
Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD

Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD role at Trilogy.

This range is provided by Trilogy. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$200.00/hr - $200.00/hr

Overview

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. This isn\'t about incremental improvements—it's about fundamentally reimagining how education works.

As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

title: Staff Product Manager | Explore&Search
description:
Overview

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager in our Explore&Search Team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Consumer Experience team in Product & Technology is responsible for evolving our product towards providing a simple, engaging and delightful partner discoverability experience, helping users start and cultivate their wellbeing journey with Wellhub.

The Explore & Search team's goal is to evolve the Wellhub app's browsing and search journeys providing users with an increasingly intuitive experience for discovering our diverse range of partners and activities, showcasing Wellhub' value proposition in order to attract, engage, and retain subscribers.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the product vision for providing a great partner discoverability experience for our Members and Subscribers.
  • Defined product requirements, actively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within Wellhub to propose new product solutions as well as to continuously review and improve the current product functionality and performance;
  • Analyze and assess product opportunities to unlock better partner discoverability and value perception of Wellhub's network
  • Build, communicate and discuss your product vision with internal stakeholders;
  • Drive product planning, build and manage high quality roadmaps;
  • Work closely with data, product design, engineering, and data science teams to deliver well rounded, scalable and stunning product features;
  • Define goals, metrics, track, and report their progress;
  • Design and run user tests, qualitative surveys, and AB tests.
  • Analyze product data to generate insights and identify opportunities that range from the end user experience all the way to the Search & Recommendation APIs, from improving the way partners are showcased on the interface to rankings and models.
  • Work closely with the Technical Program Manager responsible for the APIs to ensure planning alignment and smooth product improvements cycles.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience leading the product development of relevant consumer digital products, in close collaboration with engineering and design team members;
  • Hands on mindset, entrepreneurial and self-driven spirit with a great desire to make things happen;
  • Analytical and quantitative skills is a must, ability to use data and metrics to generate insights, iterate and improve the product;
  • Strong problem solving - be able to structure problems, prioritize and make pragmatic decisions in unstructured environments;
  • Capacity to identify and connect users needs and business needs, and develop effective ideas to meet them
  • Ability to analyze complex requirements and intricate user flows in order to translate them into simple, friendly and intuitive solutions – with attention to detail.
  • Ability to discuss high-level product decisions as well as technical details effectively when necessary
  • Experience with consumer facing digital products. Marketplace experience is a plus.
  • Experience in managing user facing products that integrate with machine learning APIs, search and recommender systems is a plus.
  • Previous experience in search and browsing product journeys is a plus.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in leading the product development of relevant consumer digital products is a mandatory requirement.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Privacy notice for Candidates (Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos).

title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Marketing Data Analyst to our Marketing B2B team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Marketing Data Analyst is an embedded analyst position that plays a key role in transforming marketing data into dashboards and reports that drive strategic decisions across marketing initiatives. This role's primary responsibility is to support Insights Managers by preparing clean, accurate, and repeatable data assets and reports. The analyst will transform business questions and challenges into queries and dashboards, ensuring that the data product ecosystem is robust and consistent for others to consume. This key player shapes marketing strategy through targeted data products, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating across teams to enable data-driven insights.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Data Preparation: Translate business or insight questions into queries, reports, and/or dashboards, and collaborate with Insights Managers on how we want to give visibility to this data (understanding the “why” and the business challenge)
  • Dashboard Creation: Build and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor performance metrics.
  • Data Governance: Ensure the consistent usage of concepts, metrics, and KPI definitions across our data products.
  • Quality Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability in our dashboards by proactively detecting possible data deviations and working with Analytics Engineers to resolve them. Develop new business quality tests for new data products.
  • Ecosystem Collaboration: Collaborate with the Global Analytics team to ensure a robust data product ecosystem and consistent reporting methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Relationship: Collaborate closely with Insights Managers and business stakeholders to understand their needs and ensure analytics deliverables align with their objectives.
  • Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related fields.
  • Previous experience with Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence or Data Science.
  • Proficiency in BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Amplitude).
  • Advanced knowledge in SQL and/or Python for data analysis and exploration.
  • Preferred knowledge of marketing technology platforms such as Hubspot, SFMC, Braze, or Segment.
  • Understanding of marketing concepts and user journeys.
  • Strong storytelling and data presentations skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience with Tableau, Metabase, Python or SQL and advanced english are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

Follow us on Instagram lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!

Voluntary Self Identification

Wellhub is committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive work environment, beginning with the application process. We recognize that we are not all alike, and this is our greatest strength. We hire talented and diverse individuals not only because it is the right thing to do, but also because it strengthens our company. We know that combining our diverse cultures, experiences, and perspectives will help us achieve our mission of making the world a healthier place.

title: Account Executive (Executivo de Vendas - Arts & Entertainment) - Brazil (Remote)
description:
Overview

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by investors including monashees, Kaszek, Canary, Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs, along with dozens of angel investors and local family offices. We are building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region and invite you to join us in a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career.

We support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an Account Executive (Executivo de Vendas) to accelerate Clara\'s growth in the Arts & Entertainment sector across Brazil. In this role, you’ll generate and close a high volume of new business opportunities through 100% outbound efforts, helping creative and digital businesses adopt Clara\'s financial and expense management solutions. This is a true hunter role—identify, engage, and convert high-potential clients in a fast-paced market. You\'ll own your pipeline end to end—from cold outreach to closing—representing Clara with clarity, discipline, and energy. Success will be measured by your ability to consistently exceed new client acquisition and deal volume targets.

  • Own the outbound sales motion for the Arts & Entertainment vertical, from lead sourcing to signed contracts
  • Generate a high volume of qualified leads through proactive prospecting, calls, and digital outreach
  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of opportunities, ensuring a steady flow of new contracts
  • Engage key decision-makers in creative, media, and entertainment companies
  • Set and consistently exceed monthly and quarterly sales goals
  • Track and optimize performance against KPIs such as outreach volume, conversion rate, and closed deals
  • Maintain detailed records of all sales activity and client interactions using Hubspot CRM
  • Act as a brand ambassador, clearly communicating Clara\'s value proposition to potential clients

Who you are

We\'re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

  • Must haves
  • Proven track record of exceeding outbound sales targets in a SaaS environment
  • Strong hunter profile with success in high-volume prospecting and deal generation
  • Experience selling to or understanding the Arts & Entertainment, digital media, or creative industries
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation abilities
  • Strong pipeline management skills and ability to own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working independently
  • Based in Brazil
  • Working proficiency in Portuguese
  • Intermediate proficiency in English (reading, writing, and verbal communication)
  • Nice to haves
  • Network within the arts, media, or entertainment ecosystem
  • Experience in financial services or expense management SaaS
  • Basic proficiency in Spanish or a desire to learn
  • Experience or interest in using AI tools to automate workflows
  • A good sense of humor

Why join Clara

At Clara, you\'ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

  • We\'re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.
  • Certified as one of the world\'s fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup.
  • Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.
  • Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.
  • Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.
  • Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

  • #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.
  • #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.
  • #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.
  • #Pride. We build products and experiences we\'re proud of.
  • #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.
  • #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one
  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)
  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths
  • High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together
  • Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact
  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you\'re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

title: Marketplace Manager
description:
About the Job


Draiver is an industry-leading self-learning logistics platform that enables vehicle movement planning, coordination, and execution. We connect businesses to transport services and independent contract drivers, providing GPS routing, tracking, digital documentation, and payment solutions in one simple application. Our platform empowers companies to streamline operations while drivers gain flexible access to opportunities.


We are looking for a Marketplace Manager to play a pivotal role at the intersection of operations and product. This person will oversee the growth and health of our driver marketplace, ensuring we deliver the best experience for drivers and partners, while collaborating closely with product and engineering to shape platform improvements.


This is a unique opportunity to manage dynamic multi-country markets, drive measurable business impact, and influence the roadmap of a global gig-economy platform.


What You’ll Do



  • Own marketplace performance across supply and demand, identifying opportunities to improve driver engagement, retention, and efficiency.

  • Work cross-functionally with product, operations, data, and business development teams to design and execute strategies that scale sustainably.

  • Collaborate with product management to define requirements and prioritize features that improve marketplace balance, transparency, and user experience.

  • Launch and optimize new markets, setting up operational frameworks, KPIs, and success metrics.

  • Monitor performance data to detect trends, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements to driver onboarding, trip allocation, pricing, and compliance processes.

  • Act as a bridge between marketplace realities and product development, ensuring product decisions are informed by operational insights.

  • Build business cases for new initiatives and drive projects end-to-end, from ideation to execution.

  • Partner with local teams and leadership across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Canada, and other markets to align strategies and share best practices.


Basic Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in marketplace operations, product management, consulting, or a similar data-driven role.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to structure problems, interpret data, and translate insights into action.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work across countries and cultures.

  • Hands-on mentality with resilience, adaptability, and a bias toward execution.

  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, charts) and comfort with data tools.


Bonus Points If



  • You have direct experience managing a two-sided marketplace or gig economy platform.

  • You have technical skills in SQL, Python, or dashboarding tools (e.g. Superset).

  • You bring product management or product operations experience, especially in defining requirements and working with engineering/design teams.

  • You have working proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese.


Why Join Draiver


At Draiver, you’ll be at the core of a global company that is transforming vehicle logistics. You’ll gain exposure to multiple markets, work with a diverse international team, and directly shape the evolution of our platform. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving complex marketplace challenges, and wants to grow as both a business and product leader.
