Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn\'s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You\'re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit). You\'ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will

Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Overview

Position: Operations Manager — Full-Time Employee (Brazil). Work from anywhere and help us keep the company engine running smoothly!

About the Company

The company is a fast-growing pet health brand committed to helping dogs live longer, healthier, and happier lives. We create science-backed, vet-approved products — all manufactured in the USA — and deliver them directly to customers worldwide. We're lean, scrappy, and entrepreneurial, and we’re building a team that thrives in that kind of environment.

Scope of the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, resourceful Operations Manager to lead the day-to-day business operations and ensure everything runs like clockwork. This role isn’t about managing factories or supply chains — our products are USA-made finished goods and shipped through 3PL partners. Instead, it’s about taking initiative, solving problems, creating systems, and ensuring operational excellence without needing constant oversight.

Ideal candidates are based in Brazil or LATAM, fluent in English, and comfortable working EST/CST hours. You should have experience in DTC e-commerce, ideally in human or pet supplements, and be a natural at creating order and momentum within a growing startup.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Act as the main point of contact for manufacturers, 3PL fulfillment partners, and logistics providers.
  • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate timely reorders with suppliers.
  • Troubleshoot vendor and fulfillment issues, escalating when needed and ensuring resolution.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage internal workflows (order tracking, inventory reporting, vendor communication).
  • Monitor and improve KPIs like inventory health, fulfillment speed, returns, and customer experience.
  • Develop and maintain SOPs to create consistent, scalable operational processes.

Decision-Making & Initiative

  • Proactively identify and address operational gaps or inefficiencies.
  • Anticipate risks (e.g., stockouts, shipping delays, bottlenecks) and implement solutions.
  • Share data-backed insights and operational recommendations with leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing and Customer Support to ensure product availability aligns with active promotions.
  • Partner with Finance to manage vendor invoices, track costs, and maintain budget alignment.
  • Support executive leadership with special projects and scaling initiatives.

Requirements

Years of Experience

  • 3+ years in operations, vendor management, or business coordination (e-commerce or consumer goods preferred).

Background

  • Experience working in fast-paced DTC brands — ideally with supplements (human or animal).
  • Proven track record of independently managing logistics, vendors, or internal ops workflows.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce business operations and customer experience touchpoints.

Tools and Software

  • Proficient in Google Sheets / Excel for tracking and reporting.
  • Experience using project management tools like Asana, Trello, or ClickUp.
  • Comfortable using Slack and remote communication tools.

What We’re Looking For

  • A self-starter who takes initiative and doesn’t wait for instructions.
  • Someone who spots inefficiencies and brings solutions to the table.
  • A process-driven operator who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment.
  • High-accountability team player who cares deeply about delivering results.

Why Join the Company?

  • Join a team of passionate, pet-loving people on a mission to make a difference.
  • Work remotely with flexibility, ownership, and trust.
  • Play a key role in scaling a high-growth DTC brand.
  • Grow your career as we expand our product lines and markets.

description:
Overview

About CharterUP. CharterUP is transforming the $30 billion group transportation industry with cutting-edge technology and innovative SaaS software, delivering an industry-leading experience for both customers and operators. Trusted by most Fortune 500 companies, our platform connects users to thousands of charter bus and minibus operators nationwide. In just 60 seconds, customers can access real-time availability, transparent pricing, and detailed vehicle options—whether organizing a corporate event, a company shuttle, or a wedding. By streamlining what was once a fragmented and stressful process, CharterUP brings transparency, accountability, and efficiency to an industry overdue for innovation. With CharterUP, group transportation is no longer a hassle but an elevated, reliable experience. Join us as we lead the future of group travel.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUP has achieved growth, profitability, and stability.

About the Role

Senior Product Designer to lead the design of a new, high-impact product within our growing mobility platform. This role blends UX strategy, visual design, and product thinking—from user research and usability testing to building intuitive, production-ready interfaces in Figma. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and designers, helping shape a cohesive design system and elevating the overall product experience. This position offers the opportunity to work in a startup-paced environment, where your ideas will directly influence product direction and user satisfaction.

Title: Senior Product Designer

Reports to: Chief Product Officer

What You’ll Do

  • Design from Discovery to Delivery: Conduct user research and usability testing, translate insights into wireframes and prototypes, and ship elegant, production-ready designs.
  • Own the Visual System: Create scalable, consistent design components in Figma, contributing to and expanding our design system.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with product managers, engineers, and other designers to define problems, explore solutions, and iterate quickly.
  • Champion the User: Bring a user-first mindset to ensure designs are functional, accessible, and visually cohesive across platforms.
  • Contribute to Culture: Collaborate with the broader design team (4+ designers plus UX lead) to evolve design standards, processes, and best practices.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on product design experience spanning UI and UX for web or mobile applications.
  • Figma Expertise: Deep proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, prototyping, and collaborative workflows.
  • Product Mindset: Proven success designing within software development environments, collaborating closely with engineers and PMs.
  • User-Centric Skills: Strong background in usability testing, user interviews, and turning insights into thoughtful design solutions.
  • Portfolio Quality: Work that demonstrates polished, interaction-focused design for complex digital products.
  • Communication: Excellent English skills (written and spoken).
  • Work Ethic: Startup mentality — proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Nice-to-Have: Experience designing for B2B, logistics, or other complex system-driven products.

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere we hire, with built-in flexibility. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance & Accounting Specialist.

This role is critical in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, in alignment with both local regulatory requirements and Binance’s global standards. You will be the main point of contact for accounting, tax, and regulatory matters, supporting the business in a fast-paced and high-growth environment.

Note: This role is 100% Remote, Work From Home based. Working Visa is not sponsored.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the month-end and year-end closing processes in accordance with local Brazilian regulations — particularly Receita Federal and Banco Central do Brasil — while ensuring compliance with Binance’s global finance policies.

  • Act as the primary liaison with the external accounting firm, monitoring deliverables, service quality, and outcomes.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Finance/Accounting in implementing upcoming cryptoasset regulations in Brazil, advising on impacts, requirements, and execution plans.
  • Monitor, analyze, and ensure accurate and timely submission of all regulatory reports to authorities such as the Banco Central do Brasil and Receita Federal do Brasil (e.g., CADOCs, statutory financial and tax filings).
  • Develop and maintain the company’s accounting, operational, and capital policies in line with current regulations, business needs, and Binance’s strategic directives (e.g., capital adequacy policies vs. transaction accounting).
  • Track and interpret changes in laws, resolutions, and regulatory instructions related to brokerage and payment activities, ensuring ongoing compliance and regulatory security.
  • Oversee and support all tax-related initiatives, including compliance with tax obligations, implementation of tax reform changes, and corporate reorganization or optimization projects.
  • Lead external audit activities, ensuring alignment with both regulatory requirements and Binance’s internal policies and practices.
  • Drive and support system implementation projects and the launch of new products, focusing on financial and accounting requirements.
  • Collaborate with other teams across the company on business process development, monitoring, and continuous improvement (e.g., internal audit, internal controls, policy updates).
  • Support Binance’s regional Finance and Treasury teams with inquiries, process adjustments, and compliance initiatives to align reporting and operations with corporate policies (e.g., consolidated results reporting).

Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in Controllership, Accounting Management, or Finance for banking, payment, or other regulated financial institutions.
  • Strong knowledge in accounting, finance, financial operations, cash management, tax, and payment processes.
  • Proven experience in financial products, financial back-office operations, and banking relationship management.
  • Previous exposure to core banking systems (preferred).

Why Binance

  • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

description:
Overview

CRA II - Sponsor dedicated - Brazil Home Based

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities. Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for. Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives. Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know: WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include: Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs. Chart abstraction activities and data collection Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Senior Creative Performance Strategist role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has driven billions of dollars in trackable revenue across ecommerce, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs. We accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. This role is fully remote within EST business hours and open to candidates in Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

About The Role We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’ll dive into pixels, provide tactical feedback on design and video, and connect performance frameworks with creative testing and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but focused on paid media. You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role blends creativity with data-informed decision making and reports to the Director of Creative, leading Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance through a high volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative, including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video, with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon).
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with ownership of performance results.
  • Experience collaborating with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Strong English communication skills and ability to present creative work clearly and professionally to internal teams and clients.
  • Ability to give constructive feedback to other designers and mentor their growth.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous campaign goals into visually engaging, conversion-focused concepts.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, asset handoff) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) for asset creation.
  • Bonus: experience designing high-performing ads for ecommerce, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We hire A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership and support each other relentlessly. We value autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philadelphia, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this transition.
  • Opportunities for growth through cross-functional collaboration and skill development.

Equal Opportunity Statement
Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Darkroom has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplaces, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. We accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s, and Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contributions in Marketing & Advertising.

About The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’ll dive into the pixels and provide tactical feedback on design and video, while threading together performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but focused on paid media. You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across formats including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities
  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.
Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities
  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display formats.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.
You should apply if this sounds like you:
  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. There is no room for mediocrity, and candidates not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership, but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape—just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche through cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.

About The Role

As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design process, working closely with engineers and other stakeholders to deliver high-fidelity, implementation-ready designs ahead of schedule that are directly aligned with customer needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes using Figma that effectively communicate design concepts 2 sprints ahead of engineering timelines.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent and visually compelling UI across the entire platform.
  • Leverage data pipelines to inform and enhance design decisions.
  • Ensure all current products are intuitive and self-servicing for users.
  • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.

What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.
  • Highly tech-savvy and comfortable designing for complex systems.
  • A deep, almost spiritual design philosophy that prioritizes the customer experience.
  • Skilled in conducting customer interviews and synthesizing insights into actionable designs.
  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).
  • No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Builds genuine relationships with team members and customers.
  • Positive, motivating, and supportive team player.
  • Accountable for successes and failures, with a focus on doing the job right.
  • Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coach mentality).
  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries

What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.

At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is diverse and committed to democratizing access to the global economy through Ledn's products and services.

The core values guiding Ledn are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are looking for motivated individuals to join us as we build, innovate, and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will combine innovation and creative problem solving with adaptability to the ever-changing enterprise infrastructure landscape. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholders across Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who seeks a supportive environment to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of APIs and system integration.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and calmly.
  • Strong ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages; maintain documentation and knowledge articles.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, are sensitive to different cultures, and are committed to providing a magical experience for others. You understand security concepts (PGP, OSI model) and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching). You can self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams. You are comfortable with ambiguity and can make decisions with limited data.

  • Strong organizational and task-management skills.
  • Ability to work in a remote environment.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Experience using GAM and command-line interfaces to improve efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We are looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values: adaptability, resilience, empathy, integrity, and accountability. A builder’s mindset, collaborative partner, and the ability to influence across functions are important.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package from day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and an inclusive, diverse workplace.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer. For accommodation requests during the recruitment process, you may contact the Ledn team by email. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Ledn is a global, remote-first company with team members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. title: Partner Account Manager - Public Sector
description:
Overview

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This role will join Samsara’s Global Partnerships team, which is responsible for building and activating our ecosystem of go-to-market partners across Insurance, co-sell, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Public Sector routes to market, and Fleet Management Companies.

You’ll be responsible for our Public Sector referral partners and tier 2 reseller partners - building scalable programs to drive business via Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner motions, sharing Samsara’s innovation with our partners, and helping to drive a differentiated presence in the market.

This is a great role for somebody looking to make an impact and influence the future of our Public Sector partnership strategy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

What You Will Do

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You'll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You$_39;ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.

Qualifications (continued)

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.
  • Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS; GAM and command-line interfaces; Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Has a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Is a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Has worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.
  • Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, and similar languages.
  • Experience with open source tools (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; experience with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; ability to handle shipping/receiving hardware and customs.

  • Strong documentation skills and ability to craft clear help articles; ability to manage projects and self-direct priorities.
  • Fundamental networking knowledge and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model).

Nice to haves: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM/command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Benefits

  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO; equity ownership in the company.

title: Product Manager, Lending
description:
Overview

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

As a Product Manager on the Lending Application Intake team, you’ll support the core member application experience that powers our lending platform. You’ll work closely to deliver small features that improve the speed, accuracy, and usability of loan applications — from initial intake through decisioning.

This is a hands-on learning role where you’ll develop the fundamentals of product management within a fast-paced fintech environment. You’ll learn how digital lending works, how credit unions serve their members, and how to turn complex workflows into simple, delightful product experiences, driving impact to our credit union customers and their members.

About the Team

You’ll join a high-talent density Product & Engineering org with a culture of ownership, speed, and judgment. PMs here work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and GTM peers, driving clarity and tough tradeoffs instead of waiting for direction.

This is a pivotal time at Clutch: we are on a strong growth path, and how we scale account opening in the next 12 months will define how Clutch builds durable company leverage.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turning urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence : Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills : You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility : Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites : Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays : Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options : Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup : Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget : Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note : This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch : We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

Overview

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. The core values are integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing, first-line support to employees via Slack, Jira, and other systems; own the support experience.
  • Procuring and delivering technology equipment; manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for leaving employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents as needed; prioritize help desk tickets and work across sprints in Jira.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).

  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; knowledge of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong networking fundamentals and OSI troubleshooting; basic TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • Self-management with ability to scope projects and prioritize across multiple teams; comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces for efficiency.
  • Jamf/Icva certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, resilience, and ability to work in a remote, startup/tech environment.

Perks and Benefits

  • Comprehensive rewards package and paid time off; ownership in the company via equity.
  • Remote work flexibility up to 180 days globally (subject to restrictions).
  • Inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employment; accommodations available during recruitment.

The Opportunity

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.
